name: EarlyBuffer
description: PLEASE READ THIS: Written with heavy AI-assisted drafting — but every line was hand-checked and the assist was thoroughly playtested. Not an unattended dump. · Click early — still live. Holds your jump and fires on the first shadow-sim-safe tick. Miss-assist / Pass-verdict overlay (Pick New vs Legacy). Timing assist for GD 2.2081, not an autoplayer. Final 2.2081 line · Safe Mode on by default.

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub Issues (include GD 2.2081, Geode version, platform, steps, crashlog). For chat / questions, use the Discord.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns EarlyBuffer on or off. When off, the game plays completely vanilla. The preset hotkey can also cycle to Off.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Quick starting point for how early a click may be delayed (Tight = small window, Max = large). Changing preset fills the default tick windows; your per-mode overwrites stay. Higher presets forgive more early clicks but may feel floaty. Cycle in-game with F6.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: When on, assisted or enabled runs do not save progress, bests, or percentage as a normal clear. Keep on for online/rated play. Off only if you accept that assisted runs may still write progress.

show-overlay.name: In-Level Overlay
show-overlay.description: Shows a small status line while playing (mode, buffer, learning hints). Off = cleaner screen. Pause EB button is separate.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Writes planner / SAVED lines to the Geode console. On = useful when tuning; Off = quieter console. Does not change assist strength.

perf-trace.name: Perf Trace
perf-trace.description: Times assist work every physics tick and can write earlybuffer-perf.log. On = noisy and a bit of overhead — use only when hunting hitch causes. Prefer Lag Probe for death/reset lag.

lag-probe.name: Lag Probe
lag-probe.description: Records timed death / restart / checkpoint episodes to earlybuffer-lagprobe.log (with a legend). Leave on while reporting lag spikes. Off = no episode file. Does not change how assists play.

show-trajectory.name: Trajectory Visualizer
show-trajectory.description: Draws predicted paths: gray = no click, green = earliest safe, yellow = chosen, red = latest. Helps see how wide your click window is. Off = no draw cost. Toggle: Ctrl+Shift+T.

show-pause-bake.name: Pause Bake Status
show-pause-bake.description: On pause, show short mode/bake status lines (top-left). Off = cleaner pause. Bake buttons live under EB → Bake.

show-pause-assist.name: Pause Assist Buttons (legacy)
show-pause-assist.description: Unused legacy toggle. Assist actions are under EB → Assist. Kept so old configs still load.

show-pause-hub.name: Pause EB Button
show-pause-hub.description: Shows the top-right EB button on pause, which opens EarlyBuffer settings (Main, Bake, Ingame, Assist, Visual, Modes, Keys, Dev). Off = open settings only from the Geode menu.

title-bake-actions.name: Bake Actions
title-bake-actions.description: Import a replay, build click windows, or cancel a bake. Used on the Bake settings page.

import-bake-replay.name: Import Bake Replay
import-bake-replay.description: Choose a GDR / MHR / SLC replay so Bake Map can build click windows from it. The button shows import or the loaded file name.

cycle-assist-mode.name: Cycle Assist Mode
cycle-assist-mode.description: Cycles Live → Replay → Hybrid → BruteForce. The button shows the current mode.

bake-map-action.name: Bake Map
bake-map-action.description: Builds click-timing windows from the imported replay (import a replay first). Safe to cancel mid-bake.

brute-bake-action.name: Brute Bake
brute-bake-action.description: Searches safe click timings through the level without a replay. Heavier than Bake Map; cancel if it takes too long.

cancel-bake-action.name: Cancel Bake
cancel-bake-action.description: Stops an in-progress bake. Only active while baking.

title-assist-actions.name: Assist Actions
title-assist-actions.description: Quick actions for preset, learning reset, and config files. Used on the Assist settings page.

cycle-preset-action.name: Cycle Preset
cycle-preset-action.description: Cycles Tight → Normal → Wide → Max → Off. Same idea as F6.

reset-learn-action.name: Reset Level Learning
reset-learn-action.description: Clears learned bias/trust for the current level so auto-tune starts fresh. Does not change your tick window settings.

export-config-action.name: Export Config
export-config-action.description: Saves your EarlyBuffer settings to a JSON file you can back up or share.

import-config-action.name: Import Config
import-config-action.description: Loads EarlyBuffer settings from a JSON file (overwrites current values).

save-feedback-sound.name: Save Feedback Sound
save-feedback-sound.description: Plays a short sound when assist delays your click (cue scales with how many ticks were saved). Off = silent. Does not change timing.

save-feedback-color.name: Save Feedback Color
save-feedback-color.description: Flashes your icon with Save Icon Color when a delayed click is injected. Off = no flash.

save-feedback-counter.name: Save Feedback Counter
save-feedback-counter.description: Spawns a world +N marker at the click (how many frames of earliness were forgiven). Clears on death/restart. Off = no markers. Slightly more visual clutter when on.

save-icon-color.name: Save Icon Color
save-icon-color.description: Color used for the icon flash when Save Feedback Color is on.

title-scope.name: Assist Scope
title-scope.description: Where assist is allowed: practice, start-pos, percent window, and off-ranges. Platformer is always blocked.

assist-only-practice.name: Assist Only in Practice
assist-only-practice.description: On = Live/Hybrid only work in practice. Off = also in normal mode (still respect Safe Mode and percent rules).

assist-startpos-only.name: Assist Only from Start Pos / Test
assist-startpos-only.description: On = assist only in start-pos / test mode. Off = allowed anywhere in the percent window.

assist-percent-min.name: Assist Percent Min
assist-percent-min.description: Lowest percent where assist may run (0–100). Raise this to keep the start of the level fully vanilla. Pair with Assist Percent Max. Use Off Ranges below for holes inside the window.

assist-percent-max.name: Assist Percent Max
assist-percent-max.description: Highest percent where assist may run (0–100). Lower this to stop assisting near the end (e.g. last % for a clean finish).

title-assist-off.name: Assist Off Ranges (%)
title-assist-off.description: Percent holes where assist is forced off (even inside Min–Max). Set From/To for a range; leave -1 to ignore that slot. Inclusive.

assist-off-1-from.name: Range 1 From
assist-off-1-from.description: Start of off-range 1 (%). -1 = unused. Inclusive with Range 1 To. Example: 40–55 turns assist off in that band.

ticks-all.name: Ticks (Default)
ticks-all.description: How early a click may be delayed for modes without their own overwrite (physics ticks; ~240/s, so ~4 ticks ≈ 1 frame at 60fps). Higher = more forgiveness, but clicks can feel later/floaty. Lower = snappier, less help. Wave uses Ticks (Wave) unless Wave Overwrite is on.

ticks-wave.name: Ticks (Wave default)
ticks-wave.description: Default delay window for wave when Wave → Overwrite is off. Wave is sensitive: higher values forgive more spam/early taps but can phase-shift into spikes; keep low (2) for a tight feel, raise (4–8) if you want a wider window.

title-algorithm.name: Algorithm
title-algorithm.description: How the planner decides delays: mode, bake radius, click-rate limits, CPU budgets, press/release. Smart multi-jump is the next section.

death-slack.name: Death Slack
death-slack.description: Extra look-ahead after a planned jump (not the spike zone itself). Higher = simulates a bit further past the click (more CPU, can see later gaps). Lower = shorter sims. 2 is a solid default.

look-ahead-cap.name: Look-Ahead Cap
look-ahead-cap.description: How far each candidate is simulated (physics ticks). 0 = automatic (good default). Higher = sees bigger gaps ahead, more CPU and can feel slower on weak PCs. Lower (or small auto) = faster plans, may miss distant threats.

assist-mode.name: Assist Mode
assist-mode.description: Live = plan every click now. Replay = use windows from an imported macro bake. Hybrid = use a nearby bake window when it verifies, else Live. BruteForce = use a Brute Bake map (no replay). Replay/Brute are timing maps, not a bot that clicks for you.

assist-pick.name: Pick Mode
assist-pick.description: How Live/Hybrid picks a delay inside your tick window (G1). New (default) = only delays that survive the sim, then Smart Prediction picks the first delay with the best predicted exit (further survival / reach — not a fixed mid or latest). Legacy = 1.2.0 feel: if delay 0 is already safe, click now; else latest ±k-robust (orb band still earliest). Never waits past your Limit.

bake-radius.name: Bake Radius
bake-radius.description: When baking, how many frames each click may shift while searching a window. 0 = automatic. Higher = wider searched windows (more bake time). Lower = tighter/faster bake, may miss some timings.

cps-limit.name: CPS Limit
cps-limit.description: While your recent click rate is at or above this (clicks/sec), assist pauses so spam stays vanilla. 0 = off. Higher limit = assist keeps working during denser clicking; lower = assist backs off sooner.

min-click-interval-ms.name: Min Click Interval (ms)
min-click-interval-ms.description: If you press again within this many milliseconds, assist skips that press (your vanilla click still goes through — never blocked). 0 = off. Higher = more spam left vanilla; lower = assist tries more often. Try 30–80ms if spam feels over-assisted.

assist-orbs.name: Orb Assist
assist-orbs.description: On = planner prefers delays that hit a needed orb when one matters. Off = only hazard/threat logic (orbs ignored for timing). On helps orb sections; off if orb logic feels wrong on a level.

sim-budget-us.name: Sim Budget (µs)
sim-budget-us.description: Soft time cap per click for the planner (microseconds). 1500 ≈ 1.5ms. Higher = more thorough search, more CPU hitch risk. Lower = snappier but may Pass sooner. 0 = no wall-clock limit (tick budget still applies).

tick-budget.name: Plan Tick Budget
tick-budget.description: Hard cap on how many physics ticks the planner may simulate per press. Higher = smarter/longer search. Lower = less CPU; if exhausted, assist Passes (vanilla click). Default 4000 is balanced.

assist-press.name: Assist Presses
assist-press.description: On = jump presses can be delayed by assist. Off = presses are always immediate (releases may still be assisted if Assist Releases is on).

assist-release.name: Assist Releases
assist-release.description: On = jump releases can be delayed (useful for wave/ship/robot short-hops). Off = releases are immediate.

smart-depth.name: Smart Depth (Jumps Ahead)
smart-depth.description: How many jumps ahead Live/Hybrid may look. With Pick=New, depth 1 still exit-predicts the first delay over the survivor band (single-press horizon). 2–3 also search follow-up jumps / bake chains — smarter but heavier. Replay/Brute ignore this.

smart-combos.name: Smart Combos
smart-combos.description: Max timing combinations tested when Smart Depth > 1. Higher = smarter sequences, more CPU. Lower = faster, may pick a weaker first delay. Also limited by Sim Budget.

smart-horizon.name: Smart Horizon (Ticks)
smart-horizon.description: How far (ticks) the multi-jump search looks. 0 = automatic. Higher = plans further ahead (more CPU). Lower = shorter foresight. Only used when Smart Depth > 1.

robust-k.name: Robust Window (±k)
robust-k.description: Neighbor ticks around a pick that must also be safe (±k). 0 = automatic from mode/speed/frame jitter (recommended). Higher fixed k = safer but may delay more / Pass more. 1 ≈ classic earliest±1.

robust-jitter.name: Robust firstDt Jitter
robust-jitter.description: Before locking a Delay, re-check with slightly shorter/longer first frame time (±3%). On = rejects fragile timings (extra sims, safer under unstable FPS). Off = fewer sims, default.

title-learning.name: Learning
title-learning.description: Per-level learning and optional self-bake. Learning never changes your tick window numbers — only soft bias/trust.

auto-tune.name: Auto-Tune Per Level
auto-tune.description: Learns gentle bias/trust per level and spot as you play (never changes the tick window). On = adapts over attempts. Off = no learning. Toggle: Ctrl+Shift+L. Reset level: Ctrl+Shift+R.

self-bake.name: Self-Bake (Practice)
self-bake.description: In practice, records your normal (non-assist) clicks into the bake map for later Hybrid/Replay help. Assist injects are never recorded. On = builds a personal map; Off = no recording.

self-bake-normal.name: Self-Bake in Normal Mode
self-bake-normal.description: Also record vanilla clicks outside practice. Off (recommended) = practice only so normal runs stay cleaner.

self-bake-refine.name: Self-Bake Refine Windows
self-bake-refine.description: After a segment, may widen recorded click windows (budgeted; skipped if assist touched the run). On = better windows over time; Off = point windows only (less CPU).

title-trigger-world.name: Trigger World
title-trigger-world.description: Caches moving/toggling solids for the shadow sim so plans see them more accurately. Follow-player style triggers stay special-cased.

trigger-bake.name: Trigger World Bake
trigger-bake.description: On = load/build a cache of static movers/toggles for this level and use it in the shadow sim (better plans on moving ground). Off = old behavior (movers often treated as unknown). First enter of a level may build in the background.

trigger-bake-skip-dynamic.name: Skip Dynamic Triggers
trigger-bake-skip-dynamic.description: On (recommended) = do not try to simulate follow-player / click-timed toggles in the cache (they stay unknown — safer/lighter). Off = attempt a cheap live snap to the ghost for simple lock/follow-Y cases (can help, but dual/rotate-follow still unknown).

assist-verify.name: Assist Verify
assist-verify.description: Debug only: when two planners disagree, randomly try one and log VERIFY lines (uses extra budget). Prefer Off for normal play.

cube-enable.name: Enable Cube
cube-enable.description: Allow assist while you are in Cube mode. Off = vanilla in Cube.

cube-overwrite.name: Overwrite Cube
cube-overwrite.description: On = use the Cube ticks / look-ahead / slack / latency below instead of the global preset. Off = use Defaults + Preset.

cube-ticks.name: Cube Ticks
cube-ticks.description: Max delay window for Cube (physics ticks). Higher = more early-click forgiveness in Cube; lower = snappier. Only used when Overwrite Cube is on.

cube-cap.name: Cube Look-Ahead
cube-cap.description: How far Cube candidates are simulated. 0 = use global Look-Ahead (or auto). Higher = sees further, more CPU. Only with Overwrite on.

cube-slack.name: Cube Slack
cube-slack.description: Extra look-ahead after a Cube jump. -1 = use global Death Slack. Higher = slightly longer sims. Only with Overwrite on.

cube-latency.name: Cube Latency Weight
cube-latency.description: How strongly Cube prefers earlier clicks among equally safe timings (0 = ignore delay, higher = pick earlier). Default 0.25. Higher can feel more responsive but may be less optimal for distance. Only with Overwrite on.

title-keys.name: Keybinds
title-keys.description: In-game hotkeys. Change bindings here; they apply while playing.

hotkey-cycle.name: Cycle Preset
hotkey-cycle.description: Cycles preset Tight → Normal → Wide → Max → Off (same as Cycle Preset).

hotkey-reset-level.name: Reset Level Learning
hotkey-reset-level.description: Clears learning data for the current level.

hotkey-auto-tune.name: Toggle Smart Learning
hotkey-auto-tune.description: Toggles Auto-Tune / smart learning (does not change tick windows).

hotkey-trajectory.name: Toggle Trajectory Viz
hotkey-trajectory.description: Shows or hides trajectory / click-window paths.

title-dev.name: Dev Lab
title-dev.description: Developer forensics: record assist decision traces, evaluate counterfactual delays, export reports. Not for normal play — leave recording off unless you are debugging timing.

title-dev-session.name: Dev Session
title-dev-session.description: Start/Stop recording. Keeps a rolling window of the last N counted attempts — does not auto-stop.

dev-record-enable.name: Dev Record Enable
dev-record-enable.description: Master switch for Dev Lab recording. Off = no trace overhead beyond a cheap enable check. On alone does not start a session until Start Recording is used.

dev-record-count.name: Dev Record Count
dev-record-count.description: Rolling window size (1–50, default 10): keep only the last N counted sealed attempts. Recording does not stop at N — older attempts are dropped.

dev-record-include-pass.name: Dev Record Include Pass
dev-record-include-pass.description: When recording, also trace gate Passes (CPS/scope/spam) so cause analysis is complete. Off = only Delay arms and related fire/outcome events.

dev-count-empty-attempts.name: Dev Count Empty Attempts
dev-count-empty-attempts.description: Count sealed attempts with zero pressObserved toward Record Count. Default off — empty deaths do not burn a session slot.

dev-freeze-world.name: Dev Freeze World
dev-freeze-world.description: Capture nearby object poses / restoreable world state for high-fidelity eval. Off = player+clock digest only (playerOnlyApproximated). Heavier CPU/IO when on.

dev-disable-random.name: Dev Disable Random
dev-disable-random.description: While recording, force explore / verify-AB off random so live and eval match. Default on. Turn off only if you intentionally want stochastic assist while tracing.

title-dev-eval.name: Dev Eval
title-dev-eval.description: Counterfactual delay grid, horizon, objective, and budgets. Claims require fidelity labels — see docs/dev_lab.md once shipped.

dev-eval-on-death.name: Dev Eval On Death
dev-eval-on-death.description: Automatically run counterfactual eval when an attempt seals with death (if a session is recording / has traces). Off = only Eval actions.

dev-eval-grid.name: Dev Eval Grid
dev-eval-grid.description: Which delays to evaluate. band (default) = survivors ±k plus planned/0 — cheaper. full = every delay 0..limit (required for idealDelay eligibility). sparse = 0, mid, limit, planned±2.

dev-eval-horizon.name: Dev Eval Horizon
dev-eval-horizon.description: Primary survival horizon in physics ticks after the action tick. Default 48. bestSurvivingDelay uses this window only.

dev-eval-tail.name: Dev Eval Tail
dev-eval-tail.description: Extra physics ticks after the primary horizon with no further assist input. Used by horizon_clear_v1 and shown on samples. 0 = no tail probe.

dev-objective.name: Dev Objective
dev-objective.description: Named scoring function for bestEvaluatedDelay. survive_then_endx_v1 (default) = survive primary then endX then earlier delay — never writes idealDelay. planner_mirror_v1 = live planner order. horizon_clear_v1 = only path that may set idealDelay when eligibility holds.

dev-eval-require-deps.name: Dev Eval Require Deps
dev-eval-require-deps.description: Hard-fail (notReproducible, suppress claims) when dual/triggers/clock deps marked by the live cycle are unrestored. Default on. Off allows more playerOnlyApproximated runs.

dev-record-cands.name: Dev Record Candidates
dev-record-cands.description: When recording after plan(), store per-delay reject ledger notes (and scores). Default on. Off keeps codes thinner but hurts why-not analysis.

dev-eval-budget-us.name: Dev Eval Budget (µs)
dev-eval-budget-us.description: Soft wall-clock cap for one eval pass (microseconds). 0 = no wall clock limit (tick budget still applies). Partial grids set objectivePartial.

dev-eval-tick-budget.name: Dev Eval Tick Budget
dev-eval-tick-budget.description: Hard cap on physics ticks simulated during one eval pass across the delay grid. Higher = more complete; lower = fewer hitches.

title-dev-overlay.name: Dev Overlay
title-dev-overlay.description: In-level Dev HUD (REC k/N, fidelity, bestSurv / bestEval). Off by default.

dev-overlay.name: Dev Overlay
dev-overlay.description: Show Dev Lab overlay lines while a session is active or a report is available. Off = no HUD.

title-dev-actions.name: Dev Actions
title-dev-actions.description: Session, eval, and export actions. Safe no-ops until the Dev Lab pipeline is wired.

dev-start-record-action.name: Start Dev Recording
dev-start-record-action.description: Starts a Dev Lab recording session (rolling last N). Requires Dev Record Enable. Does not auto-stop.

dev-stop-record-action.name: Stop Dev Recording
dev-stop-record-action.description: Stops and seals the current Dev Lab session, writing the session JSON under devtraces/.

dev-eval-last-action.name: Eval Last Attempt
dev-eval-last-action.description: Runs counterfactual delay eval on the latest attempt with a planFinished witness. Requires being in a level.

dev-eval-session-action.name: Eval Session
dev-eval-session-action.description: Runs eval on every attempt in the open session that has a planFinished witness. Last report kept for overlay/clipboard.

dev-export-session-action.name: Export Dev Session
dev-export-session-action.description: Shows the path to the current Dev session JSON under mod save dir /devtraces/.

dev-clear-traces-action.name: Clear Dev Traces
dev-clear-traces-action.description: Stops recording if active and deletes session-*.json under devtraces/ only. Never touches other mod files.

dev-copy-report-action.name: Copy Last Dev Report
dev-copy-report-action.description: Copies the last Dev overlay line (fid / bestSurv / bestEval / obj / ideal) to the clipboard.

title-internal.name: Internal
title-internal.description: Internal keys for old configs / preset sync. Prefer the Preset dropdown; you usually can ignore this section.

stage-index.name: Preset Index (internal)
stage-index.description: Internal copy of Preset (0=Tight … 4=Off). Do not edit — use the Preset dropdown or F6.

swallow-hopeless.name: Swallow If Hopeless (deprecated)
swallow-hopeless.description: Deprecated and unused — EarlyBuffer never blocks your clicks. Kept so old configs still load.
